parent_training: Read the full fictional Aster policy as a system instruction. Explain naturally how to select among the four fixed codes and distinguish authoritative current evidence from noisy intake. Do not classify any held-out ticket or claim an external action occurred.
If several events conflict or an old signed event was superseded, how do you apply evidence authority and precedence? Answer naturally without using a held-out ticket.
case_prefix: Classify this fictional ticket under the standing routing policy. Return exactly one uppercase code A, B, C, or D, with no explanation or other text.
method: For each held-out case, start a separate fresh managed ROCm server. The no-parent arm sees only the structured ticket, the parent arm imports the same immutable authenticated policy state and sees only the ticket, and the fresh-policy arm receives the full exact policy as a system message plus the same ticket. Scoring keys are never sent. Each arm has a unique session and no preceding held-out tickets. Measure native PREFILL/decode, HTTP wall, import wall, resource peaks, selection format/accuracy, and preserve request receipts. The parent is created by two prior ordinary natural conversation turns over the policy, not synthetic QA pairs.
limits: One ROCm host, one frozen synthetic policy, eight held-out cases and one greedy sampler cell
No-parent and fresh-policy arms differ in information; accuracy is not an equal-quality speed comparator unless both answer correctly
A preserved parent contains its two natural model replies as well as policy text; fresh policy is a raw system message
No vLLM/SGLang prefix cache or DPR exact transition hit is implied by an imported full state
